title: ONSure Agent Memory-Aware vs Memory-Blind Conflict Resolution v1
description: FR-META-058 AI Nondeterminism and Multi-Agent Assurance / 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS5 Agent Memory Assurance: 'Memory-aware 평가와 Memory-blind 평가가 충돌하면 자동 majority로 해결하지 않고 HOLD/추가 Oracle로 보낸다.' This schema covers only that one concrete, mechanically-checkable rule from SS5's broader checklist (tenant/user/project scope, write/retrieval authority, retention/deletion, poisoning provenance, stale memory handling, cross-session/cross-tenant leakage are separately covered by this codebase's pre-existing tenant-scoped RBAC infrastructure, not re-implemented here) -- when an evaluation run with the agent's memory available (memory-aware) disagrees with the same evaluation run with memory withheld (memory-blind), that disagreement itself is the signal that memory content may be influencing the verdict, and resolution is CONFLICT_HOLD with an additional oracle required, never resolved by treating either verdict as controlling.
